title: Self-Hosted Release Readiness
problem: Nako has strong subsystem architecture but lacks one repeatable self-hosted release baseline for deployment, upgrade, diagnostics, SQLite/PostgreSQL verification, API/SDK/redaction gates, backup/restore, and end-to-end smoke.

continue_policy.notes: Self-hosted release readiness is complete. Future work should open separate lanes for AI, network traversal/tunneling, Native Plugin ABI, provider breadth, SDK/package publishing, or release packaging.
